en.summary: This commit fixes modeled hardware behavior in the simulator. The clearest reusable target is the decode fix that clears pending regext state on control-flow redirects so prefix state does not leak across jumps.
why_it_counts: This repository models DUT execution semantics, so decode and LSU behavior fixes are in scope.
The commit message explicitly names real functional bugs.
The selected decode bug changes architectural behavior, not host-side tooling.
disqualifiers: The Makefile edits and some debug-print changes are ancillary.
evidence: src/sm/decode.cpp now clears WILLregext when jump or simtstk_jump is taken.
The same file separates REGEXT_ and REGEXTI_ handling, making extension state explicit.
The commit message states that jump should clear regext status and also mentions a separate PDS base-address bug.

fault_injection_plan.portable_bug_context: In an ISA that uses prefix or extension instructions to modify how the following instruction is decoded, any control-flow redirect must cancel that pending prefix state. Otherwise a prefix fetched before a jump can incorrectly extend register or immediate fields of the first instruction on the jump target path, producing architecturally wrong decoding even though the instruction stream itself is legal.

portable_injection_spec.affected_mechanism: Decode-prefix state cancellation on control-flow redirect
portable_injection_spec.trigger_condition: A regext-like prefix instruction is pending when a jump, branch redirect, or SIMT-stack redirect occurs before the prefixed instruction is consumed.
portable_injection_spec.injection_action: Preserve the pending prefix state across the redirect instead of clearing it.
portable_injection_spec.implementation_pattern: preserve stale decode prefix across flush
portability_notes: Map regext to any architectural or microarchitectural prefix state that affects only the next decoded instruction.
The bug belongs in the decode or fetch-flush boundary, not in the register file itself.
A good validation sequence executes a prefix, then a redirect, then an instruction at the target whose register or immediate fields should not be extended.
concrete_injection_steps: Locate the per-warp or per-thread decode state bit that records a pending extension or prefix.
Remove the logic that clears this state when a jump or redirect is taken.
Keep normal prefix consumption intact so the bug manifests specifically when redirects intervene.

repository_grounding.target_module_or_logic: Per-warp WILLregext decode state around jump and simtstk_jump handling
repository_grounding.commit_fix_summary: The fix clears WILLregext on jump/simtstk redirects and refines REGEXT_/REGEXTI_ handling so pending extension state is not spuriously reused.
repository_grounding.source_level_edit_anchor: Remove the added WILLregext = false assignment in the jump/simtstk path of BASE::DECODE.

fault_injection_plan.expected_failure_mode: After a redirect, the next decoded instruction can inherit stale prefix state and use wrong register numbers or immediate bits, causing incorrect simulated architectural results.
evidence_for_injection: The commit message explicitly says jump should clear regext status.
decode.cpp changes only a small amount of control logic to clear and consume the prefix state, making the bug mechanism direct.
This is a modeled-DUT semantic issue in decode, independent of build-system noise elsewhere in the commit.
notes: The same commit also fixes a vector LSU PDS base-address calculation bug in exec_lsu.cpp; either bug is real, but the regext redirect bug is the cleaner standalone injection target.
Because this is a simulator repository, the injection is a source-level semantic mutation in the model rather than an RTL wire edit.

zh.summary: 该提交修复了模拟器中的 DUT 语义建模错误。其中最清晰、最适合复用注入的是 decode 修复：在控制流重定向时清除待生效的 regext 状态，避免前缀状态跨 jump 泄漏。
why_it_counts: 该仓库建模的是 DUT 执行语义，因此 decode 和 LSU 的行为修复都在评审范围内。
提交信息明确列出了真实的功能性 bug。
选定的 decode bug 会改变架构行为，而不是主机端工具行为。
disqualifiers: Makefile 修改以及部分调试打印变更只是附带内容。
evidence: src/sm/decode.cpp 现在会在 jump 或 simtstk_jump 发生时清除 WILLregext。
同一文件还把 REGEXT_ 与 REGEXTI_ 的处理分开，使扩展状态的语义更加明确。
提交信息明确写到 jump 应清除 regext 状态，并另外提到一个独立的 PDS 基地址 bug。

fault_injection_plan.portable_bug_context: 在使用前缀或扩展指令来修改“下一条指令”解码方式的 ISA 中，任何控制流重定向都必须取消尚未消费的前缀状态。否则，在 jump 之前取到的前缀可能会错误地扩展跳转目标处第一条指令的寄存器号或立即数字段，即使指令流本身是合法的，也会得到错误的架构解码结果。

portable_injection_spec.affected_mechanism: 控制流重定向时的解码前缀状态清除
portable_injection_spec.trigger_condition: 某个 regext 类前缀已处于待生效状态，而在它被消费之前发生了 jump、branch redirect 或 SIMT 栈重定向。
portable_injection_spec.injection_action: 在重定向后继续保留这份待生效的前缀状态，而不是清除它。
portable_injection_spec.implementation_pattern: preserve stale decode prefix across flush
portability_notes: 可将 regext 映射到任何只影响“下一条解码指令”的架构或微架构前缀状态。
该错误属于 decode 与 fetch flush 边界，而不是寄存器文件本身。
合适的验证序列是：先执行前缀，再发生重定向，然后在目标路径执行一条本不应被扩展寄存器号或立即数的指令。
concrete_injection_steps: 定位记录“待生效扩展/前缀”的每 warp 或每线程解码状态位。
删除 jump 或重定向发生时清除该状态的逻辑。
保持正常的前缀消费路径不变，使故障只在“重定向打断前缀”场景下出现。

repository_grounding.target_module_or_logic: jump 与 simtstk_jump 处理附近的每 warp WILLregext 解码状态
repository_grounding.commit_fix_summary: 该修复在 jump/simtstk 重定向时清除 WILLregext，并细化 REGEXT_/REGEXTI_ 处理，避免待生效扩展状态被错误复用。
repository_grounding.source_level_edit_anchor: 删除 BASE::DECODE 中 jump/simtstk 路径新增的 WILLregext = false 赋值。

fault_injection_plan.expected_failure_mode: 重定向之后，下一条被解码的指令可能继承陈旧前缀状态，导致寄存器号或立即数位错误，从而产生错误的模拟架构结果。
evidence_for_injection: 提交信息明确说明 jump 应清除 regext 状态。
decode.cpp 只改动了少量控制逻辑来清除和消费前缀状态，bug 机制非常直接。
这是 decode 中的 DUT 语义建模问题，与提交里其他构建系统噪声无关。
notes: 同一提交还在 exec_lsu.cpp 中修复了一个向量 LSU 的 PDS 基地址计算 bug；两者都真实存在，但 regext 重定向 bug 更适合做独立注入目标。
由于该仓库是模拟器，注入方式是对模型语义做源码级突变，而不是 RTL 连线编辑。
